routes.name: Tourist entry for Canadian citizens
routes.summary: Canadians can enter as tourists with no visa for up to 180 days. The stay can't be extended. Paid work isn't allowed.

other: Passport valid at least 1 day on arrival
Onward or return ticket
No entry impediment, such as a recent conviction for an intentional crime that is illegal in both countries

savings.note: Proof of funds per month of stay or fraction of a month

sources.label: Costa Rica Consulate in Canada: Canadian citizens

routes.name: Visa exemption for Canadian PR and work/study visa holders
routes.summary: Some nationalities that normally need a visa can enter without one if they hold Canadian permanent residence or a multiple-entry Canadian work or study visa. Stay is up to 30 days.

other: Needs a Canadian PR card or a multiple-entry Canadian work/study visa stamped in the passport
Passport valid at least 180 days beyond entry
Ticket out within 30 days
A work or study permit stapled to the passport does not count
Proof of funds of USD 100 per person per month of stay

sources.label: Costa Rica Consulate in Canada: PR and visa holders

routes.name: Consular tourist visa
routes.summary: Nationalities that need a visa apply at a Costa Rican consulate. The full visa-free and visa-required lists are in the official visa directives, which I could not open. Details below come from the Ottawa consulate.

other: Which passports need a visa: check the official directives on migracion.go.cr (page was unreachable)
Ottawa consulate asks for passport valid 6+ months, round-trip ticket, proof of funds, apostilled criminal record, photo and cover letter

fees.label: Consular visa fee at the Ottawa consulate

stay.note: Visa must be used within 60 days of being stamped. Single entry.

sources.label: Costa Rica Consulate in Canada: Visas

routes.name: Youth mobility (Young Professionals and Working Holiday), Canada
routes.summary: Canadians aged 18 to 35 enter as tourists for up to 180 days, find a job, then switch to a work status. Can't bring dependents.

other: Onward ticket and letter of intent
Clean criminal record
Medical insurance covering hospitalization and repatriation
No dependents
Can't have used this category before
Wait 3 months after finishing before applying for another category
Documents apostilled and translated into Spanish

stay.note: Program looks like one year in total, page isn't explicit

fees.label: Change of status from tourist to work

sources.label: Costa Rica Consulate in Canada: Youth mobility

routes.name: Digital nomad (Stay for Remote Workers and Service Providers, Ley 10008)
routes.summary: Lets you work remotely for clients outside Costa Rica. It extends a 90-day tourist stay to one year, renewable for one more year.

income.note: USD 4,000 per month if bringing dependents. Income must come from outside Costa Rica.

other: Must provide paid remote services to clients outside Costa Rica
Medical insurance for the whole stay, minimum USD 50,000 coverage, dependents included
Bank statements for the past year with a sworn affidavit, or a certification from a public accountant or notary (apostilled or consularly legalized)
Criminal and police record checks by DGME
Spanish translations of foreign documents

sources.label: Visit Costa Rica (ICT): digital nomad requirements

documents: Passport photo page and entry stamp page

fees.label: Government payment
fees.note: Bank fees, including a USD 15 Banco de Costa Rica fee, can reduce the amount received

steps: Apply online at tramiteya.go.cr/dgme or at a DGME office

routes.name: Temporary residence categories (pensionado, rentista, inversionista, work, study, family)
routes.summary: Costa Rica has temporary residence categories including pensionado, rentista, inversionista, work, study and family. Amounts and years were not confirmed on an official page, so they are left out. Apply to the immigration agency in Costa Rica, not at the consulate.

other: Requirements for each category are on the DGME site (page was unreachable). Not confirmed here.
